name: geasa
text: geasa is the Irish plural form of the headword geis. MacKillop treats the two spellings as the same record. MacKillop records geasa in the 2008 Dictionary of Celtic Mythology as a cross-reference to the singular headword. The fuller record of the binding taboo, its its role in Irish heroic cycles, and its its ritual uses sits under geis.
